name: knife-slash
note: CU-107: the issue knife. A short cock, a thrust at arm's length, a small cut across, then back to the pose. t is 0..1 of the knife swing (0.22 s). Offsets in his own axes (x out to the knife side, y up, z forward), metres. The arm reaches the point by IK; the blade's turn in the fist is updateKnifeAnim. CL-261 part 2, from the CMU strikes 02_05 and 144_20 (the blow lands at or a little under shoulder height, 1.05-1.25 arm lengths past the chest, the arm 92-96% straight): the cock is chambered at the chest, not by the ear; the thrust goes 18 cm further out, 14 cm lower, onto his line; the chest turns and leans into it first (BLADE_BODY), so the shoulder coming through carries the hand there.
